description: 兵对兵⑤：兵的通路 — 白方利用通路兵优势取胜

intro.popup_en: The white b-pawn has a clear path, and the black a-pawn is also passed. White moves first and has the closer king. Which pawn will promote first?
intro.popup: 💡 兵的通路：白兵 b2 前方畅通无阻（通路兵），黑兵 a4 也是通路兵，但白方先走且白王更靠近。谁能先升变？

outro.popup_en: White wins. The king escorts the b-pawn toward promotion while stopping the black pawn. A passed pawn supported by its king is the key to victory.
outro.popup: ✅ 结论：白胜！ 白王能护送 b 兵升变，同时拦截黑兵。通路兵 + 王的支援 = 取胜关键。

moves.popup_en: 1. Kb3: the white king approaches the a4-pawn, preparing to capture it.
moves.popup: 1.Kb3 — 白王向 a4 靠近，准备吃掉黑的通路兵。

moves.popup_en: 1...Ke5: the black king heads toward the center to stop the white pawn.
moves.popup: 1...Ke5 — 黑王向中心进发，试图拦截白兵。

moves.popup_en: 2. Kxa4 captures the black passed pawn. Only the white b-pawn remains.
moves.popup: 2.Kxa4 — 白王吃掉黑的通路兵！现在只有白兵 b2 还在。

moves.popup_en: 2...Kd4: the black king races after the white pawn.
3. b4: the pawn advances under the white king's escort. The black king cannot catch it.
moves.popup: 3.b4 — 白兵前进！白王护送，黑王无法追上。
